notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a queued timestamped interaction whose producing federate resigns before delivery. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the C++ standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that a timestamped interaction remains queued after source resignation, that a post-resignation retraction attempt reaches the standard federate-membership boundary, and that the recipient receives exactly one callback with the original timestamp, producer, order, transport, tag, payload, and retraction metadata before its time-advance grant. No DDM, provider-specific name, registry, header, or implementation behavior is part of this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped interaction, resignation, retraction, and time-advance services with FederateAmbassador timestamped receive and grant callbacks
